enum.suffix:
Respond with exactly one word, either SUPPORTED or NOT_SUPPORTED.
No explanation. No reasoning. No other text.

ab_logprobs.suffix:
Return exactly one character:
A = SUPPORTED
B = NOT_SUPPORTED

mode_rationale: Errata E15 prescribes ab_logprobs so one call yields both label and probability. Verified live on 2026-09-19 (runs/model_live_check.json): neither required OpenAI model accepts the logprobs parameter, so ab_logprobs would yield no probability while imposing a single-character answer format that differs from Claude's. Spec rule 7 requires the same semantic prompt for every model, so all three frontier models use enum. Revisit at G2A and preregister.
